description: Generates a secure hosted authentication link for connecting a messaging channel to the user's inbox. The link is opened in a browser, where the connection is completed (scanning a QR code for WhatsApp, signing in for email or LinkedIn); the tool itself does not complete the connection. The link is single-user and expires in 30 minutes. channel is one of google (Gmail), outlook, imap, whatsapp, linkedin, linkedin_sales_navigator, linkedin_recruiter, instagram, telegram, facebook (Messenger). Requires a plan that includes messaging, and a free account slot: Pro allows 1 connected account per user, Business 3, Enterprise unlimited; Starter has none. Returns the connect url.

channel.description: Which channel to connect: google (Gmail), outlook, imap (any other email via IMAP/SMTP), whatsapp, linkedin (Classic), linkedin_sales_navigator, linkedin_recruiter, instagram, telegram, facebook (Messenger).

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: connect_messaging_account

url.description: Single-use hosted auth link, expires in 30 minutes
